reading: The sketch lays out a 7-panel grid of content cards (hero, stat callout, progress ring, quote, bar chart, code block, and CTA card), each annotated with a typed note specifying its background, text sizes/weights, colors, and copy. A run-level note sets the overall page style: black background, Helvetica type, white text.
